subject: Corner pod: demo kit manifest + sightline swap request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alexander Boothing <venue-ops@eventservices.com>, Kate Lin <kate@graphichouse.co>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Corner pod: demo kit manifest + sightline swap request

Alex / Kate —

Quick context: our corner pod (Zone C12) got reassigned one aisle over which tightens sightlines toward the neighboring sponsor. Venue ops flagged a possible sightline obstruction for our demo pedestal and suggested a minor rotation of our pod (clockwise 12–15°) at load-in. Before we commit to any floorplan change, we need to confirm two things:

1) A packing/spare kit manifest we can hand to the load-in crew so nothing critical is buried.
2) A final sightline sketch to share with venue/security (they need an official PDF).

I attached a draft manifest (redwood_corner-pod_demo-kit-manifest_v1.xlsx) and a quick sketch (sightline_sketch_A_rev3.pdf). Can Kate confirm the wrap/graphic clearance if we rotate the pod? Alex — can venue ops sign off on a small rotation and confirm the forklift/wheel-clearance constraints?

Operational asks:
- Kate: confirm whether wrap bleed and monitor mount are safe with a 15° rotation; if not, call out the dimension that blocks.
- Alex: can you confirm load-in window (we currently show Friday 08:00–11:00) and whether we can request a dolly escort for the pedestal set?
- Tessa / Sergio / Logan: review the manifest for anything we absolutely can’t skimp on in the spare kit.

Thanks — short turnaround please; we need to finalize by Friday EOD so the print house can make wrap adjustments.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
m: +1 415-555-0147

Attachments: redwood_corner-pod_demo-kit-manifest_v1.xlsx; sightline_sketch_A_rev3.pdf

From: Alexander Boothing <venue-ops@eventservices.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Kate Lin <kate@graphichouse.co>
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Corner pod: demo kit manifest + sightline swap request

Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up. We can accommodate a clockwise rotation up to 20° on load-in day; the only constraints are the aisle taper and the overhead pipe rack at the south end of C12. If you rotate 15°, you remain within clearance but the pedestal orientation will face slightly toward the main aisle (fine for demo flow).

Load-in: Friday 08:00–11:00 is confirmed. We can assign a dolly escort and a one-hour dedicated freight elevator window (09:00–10:00) for fragile items. Please tag those items on the manifest as "fragile/freight-elevator" so our crew knows.

I'll attach a venue-signed sightline note once Kate confirms dimensions; otherwise we can provisionally approve subject to updated artwork.

Best,
Alex
Alexander Boothing
Venue Ops Manager, Event Services Co.
venue-ops@eventservices.com

From: Kate Lin <kate@graphichouse.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Corner pod: demo kit manifest + sightline swap request

Marissa / Team —

Quick review of the sketch: a 15° rotation is acceptable provided we shift the left side graphic inboard by 2.5 inches to maintain the clear zone for the neighboring sponsor logo. Monitor mount OK if the VESA bracket remains centered within the 24" pedestal face (see note on page 2 of the PDF).

Two open items from the print shop:
- Our wrap file needs a 1/8" additional bleed on the top edge if you want us to adjust without re-proofing. That will add one day to print.
- The full-bleed zip contains a 48x48 raster art that currently exports at 72 dpi; we should swap that asset for the vector provided in the Drive link to avoid pixelation.

I pushed an updated print-ready package to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCornerPodAssets (folder: graphic-wrap-print-ready_v2.zip).

If you approve the 1/8" bleed change, I can sign off today and coordinate with James at Acme for crate labels.

—Kate
Kate Lin | Senior Production Designer
GraphicHouse Co.

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Apr 2028 08:59:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Corner pod: demo kit manifest + sightline swap request

Team —

I reviewed the manifest and added a couple of critical changes (see attached manifest v1 with comments):
- Marked demo laptop + backup tablet as "fragile/freight-elevator"
- Added spare HDMI dongles (3x) and a replacement mic (handheld)
- Flagged the demo pedestal fasteners (M6 screws) to be kept on top of crate A for immediate access

Logan: can you confirm we have a dedicated SDR to own the demo rotation during the show? We should have one person making the handoff and keeping the queue moving if we change angle mid-day.

Tessa: outreach for the monitor mount vendor — if the bracket needs shift, do we have one in the event closet as a hot-swap?

I also started a short-run packing checklist for the road crew.

—Sergio
Head of Field Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alexander Boothing <venue-ops@eventservices.com>, Kate Lin <kate@graphichouse.co>, James Smith <j.smith@acmefreight.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Apr 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Corner pod: demo kit manifest + sightline swap request

Thanks everyone — quick status and decisions: 

- Kate: please proceed with the 1/8" bleed change and use the vector asset I moved to Drive. Approve print and push graphic-wrap-print-ready_v2.zip to Acme for crate printing.
- Alex: confirmed; we'll tag fragile items on the manifest and need the dolly escort + elevator window (09:00–10:00). Alex, send the signed sightline confirmation to events-security when you have it.
- James: please use crate label template #C-7 and route Crate A (demo pedestal + fasteners) to the elevator window; ETA to dock Friday 07:45.
- Logan: assign an SDR (recommend: Priya Natarajan) to own demo rotation and queue management.
- Sergio / Tessa: final checklist owners for packing — Sergio will own tools/hardware, Tessa will own signage & collateral count.

I've attached the manifest with Sergio's edits and the final wrap ZIP. I'll upload a signed sightline once Alex sends it.

Let's keep this brief — if anyone sees a blocker, flag it here. Otherwise I'll mark this as final and send to print/freight.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_corner-pod_demo-kit-manifest_v1.xlsx (updated); graphic-wrap-print-ready_v2.zip
